title: WELDING MACHINE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC PUGET SOUND.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PUGET SOUND
detail_text: THIS IS A FIRM FIXED-PRICE SUPPLY TYPE CONTRACT NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound is negotiating a 100% TOTAL SMALL BUSINESS SET-ASIDE requirement for the procurement of a WELDING MACHINE, 800 AMP (Alternating Current), WITH RUNNER CART, WORK CABLE-WITH CLAMP, GAS HOSE-WITH FITTINGS, AND REGULATOR/FLOW GAUGE. See the attached solicitation for requirements. In accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will select the most advantageous offer based on the following evaluation factors: technical including delivery date, price, and past performance in no order of relative importance. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. No offeror or product qualification requirement must be met to be eligible for award. The anticipated award date is 10 February 2026. Closes on 06 March 2026 at 1:00 PM PST. All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to Roger Bowers, roger.s.bowers.civ@us.navy.mil.
